source.note: RR-54: toPptx bytes of chart and table decks that use none of the RR-54 fields (no DataColumn objects, datasets, mapping, source or formats, and only strict-decimal or number chart cells), from main before RR-54 (re-pinned to main 4ca079f, the pptxgenjs-plus 4.3.4 migration of opf-pptx#165, whose output change the owner approved). The RR-54 export must keep these bytes exactly. Regenerate only with an owner decision to change the default export. FA-03: the stacked and percent-stacked entries name the clean chart type ids (no -3x suffix), so their titles and tags, and so their bytes, changed; every other entry is unchanged. FA-23 (OPF 0.15, owner-approved breaking spec): every entry regenerated: with zero built-in catalog records the engine-default colour scheme is written as clrScheme name="OpenPresentation" (0.14 named the built-in cool-horizon record "Cool Horizon"), and chartex-native-map names the world chart type, since map is no 0.15 chart type. Generated on the FA-20 + FA-22 core branches with zero built-ins; re-run at integration with the released core 0.15. RR-59: the three entries with a table (table, styled-table, mixed-blocks) are repinned because full provenance now records every inline table as authored (the OPF_DATA_V1 tag); previousSha256 keeps the FA-23 hash and nativeSlideSha256 locks the slide XML without its customer-data tags, which is unchanged. RR-59 (AUTO-18, round trip restores absent document defaults): full provenance now records the document-level defaults a document leaves to the engine (OPF_DOCUMENT_V1.absent), so every full-mode export carries the document tag and its slide tags, also when the document states nothing else. Verified part by part against a build of main 3d2698f: with the OPF_DOCUMENT_V1 and OPF_SLIDE_V1 tag parts, their relationships, content-type overrides and custDataLst references removed, every package is byte-identical to main; only the tag parts changed. opf-pptx#175 (chart series in ECMA-376 schema order): the six entries with a line, radar or scatter chart (line, radar, scatter, scatter-two-columns, scatter-labels, mixed-blocks) are repinned because their chart part changed: line series write c:marker before c:dLbls (CT_LineSer), radar series drop the bar-only c:invertIfNegative (CT_RadarSer), and the scatter X c:valAx drops the category-axis-only c:auto, c:lblAlgn and c:noMultiLvlLbl (CT_ValAx). Verified part by part against a build of main d7ae170: ppt/charts/chart1.xml is the only changed part of each package; every other entry is byte-identical. previousSha256 of those six entries is their main d7ae170 hash (mixed-blocks: its FA-23 hash was c5617168f7ff0601b401c939e0d174f70586d02ea0f7268bd36e491398f2eb75); nativeSlideSha256 is unchanged. RR-81: explicit owner-authorized OPF 0.19 default-export update (design section 8), independently reviewed before repinning. Baseline converter 991023c, core fe9fe3fa2c3ad0130e271b73d9853f66e920c1d5, renderer 9fbddcb78dbebcb87355922ca92af7d26c24c48d, Node 24.21.0. All 21 archives add OPF auto titleOnly layout/relation/tag and registrations. Every changed slide XML differs only by native title placeholder and noGrp locks. Chart parts, chart relationships, workbooks, embeddings, themes and diagnostics are unchanged. Three native-slide hashes intentionally reflect those title bindings. Previous RR-81 hashes are retained. Archive acceptance is not native raster acceptance. RR-20 (OPF 0.19 area arrays): approved source-derived archive refresh against frozen core 8f70cf1b52dc4ca4eb246a6f9d065b1403edbf31, gallery 146e477196405fe7d2283008f6fad34c12742599 and candidate PPTX converter. The prior RR-54 SHA is retained in rr20PreviousSha256. Independent 21-case proof: historical published source reproduces all 21 archived bytes under either preserved or new coherent core/gallery graph; 19 candidate archives change, pie and doughnut remain byte-identical. All ZIP part sets/counts are identical; chart parts differ only by neutral 3AC67A to 475569 and four zero-domain minima; table slides only by neutral borders and authored numeric right alignment. Chart/workbook data, slide text and OPF authored data are unchanged. OPF data tags only update evidence hashes and slide tags only native.style hashes. Review receipt: docs/evidence/rr20-array-areas/rr54-archive-review.json. This archive acceptance is not native raster acceptance. RR-20 row-data provenance: independently reviewed and approved update of only single-column against baseline converter e673f106c2fd38fcb5d51db190649c3855cc1885. Adds OPF_DATA_V1 for an authored single column actually plotted against synthetic row numbers. Only that tag, its content-type override, slide relationship and customer-data link change; every native part and all other archives remain byte-identical. Prior hash and size are retained; evidence: docs/evidence/rr20-row-data-provenance/archive-review.json. Native raster acceptance remains separate. Regenerated for RR-94 (tag parts only: text-shape fingerprints and OPF_IMAGE_V1 on every image block). Regenerated for RR-90 (opf-pptx 0.22.1): chart text is core chartTextSize, so chart part text sizes changed. Regenerated for LH-59 (bar only): a horizontal bar chart lists its categories top to bottom, so its chart part writes c:catAx orientation maxMin and c:valAx crosses max; every other archive is byte-identical. Regenerated for LH wave 2 (opf#968 to opf#975): column, column-labels, line, area, stacked-column, percent-stacked and mixed-blocks move only in ppt/charts/chart1.xml (LH-03 and LH-81: small-chart value labels without the value axis, gridlines or panel, and the header legend and caption at core's manual layout); pie and doughnut move because their two series are now nested rings (LH-60: chart part, workbook, slide, its relationships, content types and the OPF data tag recording the fallback); treemap moves only in ppt/charts/chartEx1.xml (LH-56 tile label colours). Verified part by part against a build of codex/lh-wave-1; every other archive is byte-identical. Prior hashes and sizes are kept as lhWave2PreviousSha256 and lhWave2PreviousBytes. Regenerated for the PR #976 treemap label fix: each tile's cx:dataLabel paragraph holds a CATEGORYNAME text field (PowerPoint drew a point label whose paragraph held no text as an empty label), so treemap moves only in ppt/charts/chartEx1.xml, which is the earlier wave 2 part with the fields added; every other archive is byte-identical. The wave 2 hash and size before the fix are kept as lhWave2LabelFieldPreviousSha256 and lhWave2LabelFieldPreviousBytes. Regenerated for layout-harvest wave 5 (LH-125): bar moves only in ppt/charts/chart1.xml (horizontal bar value labels at the bottom, c:tickLblPos nextTo) and waterfall only in ppt/charts/chartEx1.xml (the dashed connector line on the series and no line on each bar), checked part by part against an export of main 23cc70d45; every other archive is byte-identical. Prior hashes and sizes are kept as lhWave5PreviousSha256 and lhWave5PreviousBytes. Regenerated for layout-harvest wave 6 (LH-141): column, column-labels, bar, line, area and stacked-column move, checked part by part against an export of main 581ef9838: their four-digit values group, so ppt/charts/chart1.xml writes #,##0 as the series label and value axis number format; in stacked-column the grouped tick labels are wider, so the plot area starts further right in chart1.xml and the end labels and their markers in ppt/slides/slide1.xml (with ppt/tags/opfSlide1.xml) move with it. Every other archive is byte-identical. Prior hashes and sizes are kept as lhWave6PreviousSha256 and lhWave6PreviousBytes.

rr90FirstUseLayoutReview.candidateCore: codex/rr-90-first-use-layout (opf#717: RR-90 table type size, RR-91 footer zones, RR-93a tag and rich cells)
rr90FirstUseLayoutReview.evidence: Compared every archive part by part against a build of the same converter (main b62bf23, RR-94) with core main. The 27 chart-only archives change only ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml: the unused date, footer and slide-number placeholders take core's new footer-zone geometry (content inset, three columns with a 2% gutter). The table, styled-table and mixed-blocks archives also change ppt/slides/slide1.xml (table cell text at the 25 px body size and its row heights) and the ppt/tags/opfData1.xml part that records them. Charts, workbooks, themes, layouts, notes masters and diagnostics are byte-identical.
